{{Quote|The third killer went to my quarters. Broke in as slickly as I broke in here and confronted my wife in our bedroom, where she was packing to leave. She shot him, a twin burn to the gut. He took a while to die. She said he kept murmuring.|Garik Loran|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Garik Loran's apartment''' was located in a high rise building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he lived with his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Dia Passik]], and their adopted daughter, [[Adra Passik]].<ref name="MK" /> 

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref>, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Human assassin (Garik Loran)|assassin]] went to Loran's apartment to kill his family. The [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] broke into the apartment after Loran, who had survived an earlier [[Attempted assassination on Garik Loran|assassination attempt]] involving the explosion of his [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], secretly warned Dia via [[Comlink/Legends|commlink]]. The assassin confronted Dia while she was packing to leave, but she shot him twice in the abdomen, leaving him mortally wounded.<ref name="MK" />
